name: Dealership Sales Call
description: Structured notes for dealership / vehicle sales calls: customer needs, vehicle interest, trade-in, numbers, objections, and next steps.

sections.title: Call Summary
sections.instruction: One paragraph: who called, what they want, and where the deal stands.

sections.title: Customer Profile
sections.instruction: Name, contact info, current vehicle, and how they heard about us.

sections.title: Vehicle Interest
sections.instruction: Specific vehicles discussed: year, make, model, trim, stock number if mentioned, and must-have features.

sections.title: Trade-In
sections.instruction: Trade-in vehicle details, condition notes, mileage, payoff if mentioned, and expectations on value.

sections.title: Numbers Discussed
sections.instruction: Any prices, payments, terms, rates, down payments, or figures quoted. Include the exact numbers and context. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| Figure | Context | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Objections & Concerns
sections.instruction: Concerns the customer raised (price, payment, timing, vehicle condition, competitor comparisons) and how they were addressed.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Committed follow-up actions with owner and timeframe. Include appointments set (date/time) and what to prepare. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Action | When | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
